dimensions.assessment: Extends maximum lease terms from shorter periods to up to 99 years, expanding economic development opportunities on tribal lands.
dimensions.evidence: authorize leases of up to 99 years for land in the Mashpee Wampanoag Tribe Reservation

importance_detail.rationale: This bill amends leasing authority specifically for two named tribes in Massachusetts to allow leases of up to 99 years on trust and reservation land.
